using CUDA

# Custom memory allocator
mutable struct AlphaFoldMemoryPool
    gpu_cache::Dict{Int, CuArray}
    cpu_cache::Dict{Int, Array}
    allocation_stats::Dict{String, Int}
    
    function AlphaFoldMemoryPool()
        new(Dict{Int, CuArray}(), Dict{Int, Array}(), Dict{String, Int}())
    end
end

function get_cached_array(pool::AlphaFoldMemoryPool, size::NTuple, dtype::Type; on_gpu::Bool=true)
    key = hash((size, dtype, on_gpu))
    
    if on_gpu
        if haskey(pool.gpu_cache, key)
            pool.allocation_stats["gpu_cache_hits"] = get(pool.allocation_stats, "gpu_cache_hits", 0) + 1
            return pool.gpu_cache[key]
        else
            arr = CUDA.zeros(dtype, size)
            pool.gpu_cache[key] = arr
            pool.allocation_stats["gpu_allocations"] = get(pool.allocation_stats, "gpu_allocations", 0) + 1
            return arr
        end
    else
        if haskey(pool.cpu_cache, key)
            pool.allocation_stats["cpu_cache_hits"] = get(pool.allocation_stats, "cpu_cache_hits", 0) + 1
            return pool.cpu_cache[key]
        else
            arr = zeros(dtype, size)
            pool.cpu_cache[key] = arr
            pool.allocation_stats["cpu_allocations"] = get(pool.allocation_stats, "cpu_allocations", 0) + 1
            return arr
        end
    end

// Chapel distributed optimization
config const numNodes = 32;
config const gpuPerNode = 8;
config const maxConcurrentJobs = 1024;

// Ultra-scalable distributed protein folding
proc distributedAlphaFoldPipeline(jobs: [] string) {
    // Locality-aware task distribution
    const LocaleGrid = reshape(Locales, {numNodes, 1});
    const JobSpace = {0..#jobs.size};
    const DistributedJobs = JobSpace dmapped Block(boundingBox=JobSpace);
    
    // Advanced load balancing algorithm
    var loadBalancer = new LoadBalancer(numNodes * gpuPerNode);
    
    // Fault-tolerant execution with checkpointing
    coforall loc in Locales {
        on loc {
            var localGPUPool = new GPUPool(gpuPerNode);
            var checkpointManager = new CheckpointManager(loc.id);
            
            // Process local job batch
            forall jobIdx in DistributedJobs {
                if (jobIdx % numLocales == loc.id) {
                    var job = jobs[jobIdx];
                    var gpu = localGPUPool.acquire();
                    
                    try {
                        var result = processProteinJob(job, gpu, checkpointManager);
                        storeResult(result);
                        checkpointManager.markCompleted(jobIdx);
                    } catch e: ProteinFoldingError {
                        checkpointManager.markFailed(jobIdx, e);
                        // Automatic retry logic
                        retryJob(job, gpu);
                    } finally {
                        localGPUPool.release(gpu);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Advanced memory-aware batching
proc optimizedBatchProcessor(sequences: [] string): [] ProteinStructure {
    const maxBatchSize = calculateOptimalBatchSize();
    var results: [0..#sequences.size] ProteinStructure;
    
    // Dynamic batching based on sequence length and GPU memory
    var batches = createAdaptiveBatches(sequences, maxBatchSize);
    
    forall batch in batches {
        var batchResults = processBatch(batch);
        // Scatter results back to original indices
        forall (result, idx) in zip(batchResults, batch.indices) {
            results[idx] = result;
        }
    }
    
    return results;
}

                data = msgpack.unpackb(decompressed, raw=False)
            else:

            # Non-blocking message processing
            await self.message_queue.put(data)

type ProteinAuditContract struct {

// LogProteinAccess - immutable logging to blockchain
func (pac *ProteinAuditContract) LogProteinAccess(ctx contractapi.TransactionContextInterface, 
                                                  record ProteinAccessRecord) error {
    
    // Verify digital signature
    if !pac.verifyDigitalSignature(record) {
        return fmt.Errorf("invalid digital signature")
    }
    
    // Check compliance requirements
    if err := pac.validateCompliance(record); err != nil {
        return fmt.Errorf("compliance violation: %v", err)
    }
    
    // Generate immutable record ID
    recordBytes, _ := json.Marshal(record)
    recordHash := sha256.Sum256(recordBytes)
    record.ID = fmt.Sprintf("%x", recordHash)
    
    // Store to ledger (immutable)
    recordJSON, err := json.Marshal(record)
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }
    
    return ctx.GetStub().PutState(record.ID, recordJSON)
}

// QueryAccessHistory - tamper-proof access history
func (pac *ProteinAuditContract) QueryAccessHistory(ctx contractapi.TransactionContextInterface,
                                                    proteinHash string) ([]*ProteinAccessRecord, error) {
    
    // Query by protein hash with rich queries
    queryString := fmt.Sprintf(`{
        "selector": {
            "protein_hash": "%s"
        },
        "sort": [{"timestamp": "desc"}]
    }`, proteinHash)
    
    resultsIterator, err := ctx.GetStub().GetQueryResult(queryString)
    if err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }
    defer resultsIterator.Close()
    
    var records []*ProteinAccessRecord
    for resultsIterator.HasNext() {
        queryResponse, err := resultsIterator.Next()
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
        
        var record ProteinAccessRecord
        err = json.Unmarshal(queryResponse.Value, &record)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
        records = append(records, &record)
    }
    
    return records, nil
}

func (pac *ProteinAuditContract) validateCompliance(record ProteinAccessRecord) error {

        }
    }
